name: Graph API Emailing
brief: B2B guest and member users send email from BC using their own work address via Microsoft Graph.
description: Open-source per-tenant extension. Guest and member users send email from their real home-tenancy identity using Microsoft Graph Authorization Code Grant (PKCE S256, delegated Mail.Send). Interactive sign-in popup on first use per session; silent token refresh thereafter. Supports multiple home tenants via domain-matched App Registrations. Also supports shared mailboxes via Client Credentials. Depends on Rest Client OAuth by AJ Kauffmann.
